## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List commands run and their results.

- [ ] Meaningful regression cases cover changed behavior and false positives.
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run scan` pass.
- [ ] Relevant docs, both READMEs and CHANGELOG are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, runtime dependencies or network calls were added.
- [ ] Hook wire contract and CLI exit codes remain compatible.
